name: smtp-edc
description: SMTP Enhanced Diagnostics Client - Test and diagnose SMTP servers with comprehensive tools
long_description: SMTP-EDC is a powerful SMTP testing and diagnostic tool that provides comprehensive capabilities for testing email server connections, sending test emails, validating email addresses, and managing email templates. This extension brings full SMTP testing capabilities to your AI assistant through the Model Context Protocol.

tools.name: smtp_test_connection
tools.description: Test SMTP server connection and capabilities

tools.name: smtp_validate_addresses
tools.description: Validate email addresses with optional MX record checking

default_server.title: Default SMTP Server
default_server.description: Default SMTP server hostname to use (e.g., smtp.gmail.com, smtp.office365.com)

default_port.title: Default SMTP Port
default_port.description: Default SMTP server port (587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL/TLS, 25 for plain)

default_auth_type.title: Default Authentication Type
default_auth_type.description: Default authentication method (plain, login, cram-md5, oauth2)

use_starttls.title: Use STARTTLS
use_starttls.description: Enable STARTTLS for secure connections (recommended for port 587)

skip_tls_verify.title: Skip TLS Verification
skip_tls_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (use only for testing)

debug_mode.title: Debug Mode
debug_mode.description: Enable debug logging for SMTP operations

timeout.title: Connection Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout for SMTP connections in seconds

allowed_attachment_types.title: Allowed Attachment Types
allowed_attachment_types.description: Comma-separated list of allowed file extensions (e.g., pdf,doc,jpg)

enable_mx_validation.title: Enable MX Validation
enable_mx_validation.description: Validate email addresses by checking MX records
